title: core long-history decision round
expectation: same Goal Session resumed from long history; trusted suffix+title bound; exact dispatch receipt; one primary stream; bounded candidate
actual: same Goal Session resumed; candidate text, exact input seq=2011 and assistant seq=2013, one model call, observed accounting

title: extra unregistered core input
expectation: only the owner input plus at most the exact cwd runtime snapshot may enter the core request; any other user message is rejected before/at the stream boundary
actual: round refused with "Core native context has no distinct official message identity"; no candidate/context receipt

title: core pending inbox blocks
expectation: an unknown pending native input on the resumed Goal Session blocks the decision before any dispatch/model call; the input is preserved
actual: decision refused with "Unknown native inbox blocks Core Goal recovery"; input preserved; zero dispatch/model

title: foreign write during onDispatch
expectation: a foreign native input appended while onDispatch awaits must be detected by the synchronous live baseline recheck before dispatch; no candidate, no context receipt
actual: round refused with "Native history changed outside the trusted recovery suffix"; no candidate/context receipt, accounting preserved

title: foreign write during core gate await
expectation: the dispatch gate rechecks the live baseline after an authorization await, so a write landing there is refused before any model call
actual: round refused with "Native history changed outside the trusted recovery suffix"; zero model calls
